title: EEOS-O Phase 1.4 Work Package DAG Graph Schema
description: Formal JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 specification defining the structural contract for Phase 1.4 Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) nodes, edges, dependencies, and execution graph topology.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this DAG graph specification schema.

graphId.description: Unique deterministic identifier of the DAG execution graph instance.

wpId.description: Identifier of the parent Work Package Contract (DO_WP) from Phase 1.1.

correlationId.description: Unique RFC 4122 UUIDv4 correlating this DAG instance with the overarching transaction.

graphState.description: Macro-orchestration lifecycle state of the execution graph.

nodes.description: Collection of schedulable execution nodes in the DAG.

edges.description: Collection of directional dependency edges connecting nodes in the DAG.

nodeId.description: Unique deterministic node identifier within this graph, derived as NODE-${taskId}.

taskId.description: Unique identifier of the bound Phase 1.2 Task Contract (strictly 1:1 bijective with nodeId = NODE-${taskId}).

nodeType.description: Topological classification of bound task node via deterministic precedence: JOIN_GATEWAY (inDegree >= 2) > FORK_GATEWAY (outDegree >= 2) > ROOT (inDegree == 0) > TERMINAL (outDegree == 0) > STANDARD.

structuralState.description: Macro-orchestration structural eligibility state of the node.

stageIndex.description: Topological layer or wave index calculated during graph validation.

predecessors.description: List of nodeIds that must satisfy dependencies before this node becomes eligible.

successors.description: List of nodeIds that depend on the completion of this node.

assignedSpecialistRole.description: Specialist agent role required for this task.

allowedPaths.description: Filesystem path confinement whitelist inherited from Task Contract.

priority.description: Deterministic tie-breaking priority key (lower number = higher priority).

edgeId.description: Unique deterministic edge identifier within this graph (strictly unique across all graph edges under Invariant I-04).

sourceNodeId.description: Predecessor node identifier (A in A -> B).

targetNodeId.description: Successor node identifier (B in A -> B).

dependencyType.description: Semantic nature of the dependency constraint.

edgeState.description: Current lifecycle status of the dependency edge.

requiredArtifacts.description: Optional list of artifact tokens or paths required from source node.

isAcyclic.description: True if topological sort verifies zero directed cycles.

maxLayerDepth.description: Maximum stageIndex across all execution layers.

deterministicSortOrder.description: Deterministic ordered sequence of nodeIds produced by topological sort.
